name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
description: Explore Bohemia side by side. The host's world is shared with a friend: the same NPCs, weather, doors and fights.
hostSteps: Download the mod above, then press Host a game. Cairn starts Kingdom Come: Deliverance II for you.
In the game's menu choose Start Game, then New adventure or one of your saves.
Press Invite to ask a friend on Cairn, or send them your host code.
joinSteps: Download the mod above, then press Join a game.
Pick your friend in the list, or type the host's code. Cairn starts the game for you.
In the game's menu choose Join Game once the host is in the world. You arrive beside them.

items.name: Host and join
items.detail: Join by Steam code, address or from the friends who are hosting. Both players need the same version of the mod.

items.name: Same world
items.detail: The host's world is sent to the joiner, who loads it: the same NPCs, horses, items, chests, doors and weather.

items.name: Start and Join on the game's menu
items.detail: Start Game, Join Game and a new adventure straight from the game's own main menu.

items.name: Stay together
items.detail: A leash warns and then pulls a player who strays.

items.name: Sleep and wait together
items.detail: Sleeping and waiting are decided by both players, and time moves for both.

items.name: Characters kept
items.detail: The host keeps each joiner's character and gives it back when they join again.

items.name: Partner's figure
items.detail: Name above their head, health, walking, running, jumping, crouching and riding, with their clothes and weapons.

items.name: Everything they do
items.detail: Hands and items, doors, herbs, whistle, carrying, minigames and the game's body animations.

items.name: On the map
items.detail: The other player is drawn on your map and moves with them.

items.name: Fighting together
items.detail: Players hit NPCs, NPCs fight back, and the swings are shown on both screens.

items.name: NPCs can hurt a joiner
items.detail: Blows from NPCs, guards and dogs reach the joiner and can knock them down or kill them.

items.name: Friendly fire
items.detail: Players can hurt each other; the host decides if it is on.

items.name: Crime and guards
items.detail: A crime counts for both players or only the one who did it, and guards pursue the guilty one.

items.name: Shared quests
items.detail: Quests and objectives follow the host; the joiner catches up.

items.name: Shared cutscenes
items.detail: When the host's cutscene starts, the joiner holds their input and plays the same scene.

items.name: In-game mod menu
items.detail: Insert opens the mod's menu, drawn by the launcher: name badges, partner on the map, friendly fire, crime, leash, sleep vote, connection and more.

items.name: Collect everyone's logs
items.detail: The host can collect every player's logs into one folder with one button; the joiners are told when this happens.

items.name: DLSS 5 (RTX cards)
items.detail: A tick in the game's settings puts DLSS 5 into the game through DLSS 5 Autopilot and OptiScaler, and takes it out again. Community software, never tried with Cairn in a real session.
